claim_scope: 5000-image (2500-frame) OpenLORIS corridor1-1 tier, GT-free candidate generation/matching/admission; ground truth used only for the post-map score in stage f
background: The frozen 5k base reconstruction (31521 verified SIFT pairs) leaves 567 unregistered frames (frame 1931, and 1934..2499 contiguous) because base pair coverage supplies no synchronized cross-sensor stereo edge into that tail (pair-graph audit: only 1 same-frame cross-sensor pair / 77 correspondences in all 31521 base pairs; 0 inside the tail's own 5376 pairs). This experiment adds a small GT-free stride-8 synchronized-stereo probe across that tail, re-verifies it under the frozen ratio-0.8 policy, merges it after the base prefix, and maps with a new --rank0-pair-prefix guard so the added edges cannot perturb the already-registered rank-0 component.

stage_a_candidate_generation.pair_rule: one synchronized cam1<->cam2 pair per target frame (max_frame_gap=0), no cross-frame or cross-target pairs

decision.rank0_prefix_guard: adopted as the mapper policy for admitting GT-free stereo bridges without perturbing the frozen primary component
decision.summary: --rank0-pair-prefix is deterministic (repeat mapper run byte-identical across all 8 model files) and rank-0 is byte-invariant to the added stereo edges (component-000 cameras/images/points3D.txt sha256 match the base-only reconstruction exactly). This is a registration diagnostic with post-hoc GT scoring, not a COLMAP-parity or performance claim, and the 5000-image tier is development scale, not a held-out result. Global-descriptor retrieval v5 is rejected at 5k (per prior sessions' safety-audit findings; not revisited in this report).
decision.not_claimed: COLMAP parity, wall-clock/performance superiority, or held-out generalization beyond the 5k development tier
decision.next: diagnose the remaining 46 unregistered frames (rank1's unregistered_below_sensors=46, identical in both the original and repeat mapper runs) under the existing gates: rank0 SHA non-regression, rank1 RMSE/p95 non-regression, bounded pairs/RSS, and no GT tuning (ground truth stays post-hoc-scoring-only, never used to select candidates, matches, or admission thresholds)
